text: Lina: quick pass on the Trace Viewer actions I did this morning 4dd3fb Carlos: thx 44d3fb can you list the specific issues? Lina: sure 4c4 TL;DR: export CTA copy ambiguous, filename not descriptive, copy-corr button ordering/a11y, and the stack frame toggle text is confusing for screen readers. Mei: specifics please so we can file small PRs. Lina: 1) Export text is just "Download" 4e5 975. Users don't know if it's a zip or json. I suggest "Export trace (.zip)" when snapshots are included. Lina: 2) Filename: right now backend returns trace.json. Suggest pattern: trace--YYYYMMDD.zip. Makes it easy to find in downloads. Lina: 3) Correlation ID pill: copy icon is before the id on mobile, so VoiceOver reads "button" then the id. DOM order should be id text then copy button, and the button needs aria-label: "Copy correlation id 98ab". Carlos: good catch. we'll flip DOM order on small widths. Mei can you own aria-label change? Mei: yup. Will add i18n key copy.corr_id = "Copy correlation id {id}" and use it in the button. Lina: 4) Stackframe toggle uses the word "more" which is ambiguous. For a11y use "Show full stack" / "Hide full stack" and toggle aria-expanded. Mei: also add sr-only text on the icon-only toggle: e.g. "Show full stack for frame 3". Carlos: backend note: we set Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="trace.json". If we change to zip we should set Content-Disposition accordingly and include X-Trace-Filename header so frontend can render expected name before download. Carlos: also, if we always bundle snapshots currently we should default to .zip label. If we later support single-json option we can switch label dynamically. Lina: analytics: keep event stable but add props. emit trace.export with {source: "toolbar", format: "zip", corr_id: "98ab"}. Plus trace.export_ui_location to differentiate header vs drilldown. Mei: keyboard/navigation: on narrow widths Export moves into overflow "More" menu. Right now arrow key nav is broken; we need roving tabindex + arrow keys and focus trap while menu open. Carlos: agreed. I'll implement menu keyboard behavior and ensure Export stays visible longer (hide Share before Export) so it doesn't go into overflow until really tight. Lina: small CSS note: if we switch text to "Export trace (.zip)" it wraps on small headers. Add white-space: nowrap to the CTA or fall back to icon-only with aria-label. Mei: i'll update Figma and add icon-only state with sr-only label and a tooltip that reads "Export trace (.zip) — Shift+E" for shortcut hint. QA: add axe rule checks for copy button aria-label, export aria-haspopup correctness, and aria-live announcement when download completes. Carlos: good. I'll open two PRs: frontend markup/CSS + menu behavior; backend Content-Disposition + X-Trace-Filename. Will add unit tests for keyboard nav and CI axe checks. Lina: i'll update copy in the design system: export.trace.zip = "Export trace (.zip)", export.trace.json = "Export trace (JSON)", copy.corr_id = "Copy correlation id {id}". Mei: small accessibility snippet for engineers (pasteable): ``` corr: 98ab ``` Carlos: thanks. i'll include X-Trace-Filename and a small API change so frontend knows to expect .zip when snapshots present. also will emit analytics event when copy button clicked (data-analytics-id = "copy_corr_toolbar"). Lina: can we get these into a patch release? small, high impact. Carlos: yes, target patch. assigning labels: a11y, ux, perf. Dev-Bot: Remember to add a changelog line to each PR and request a11y review. :robot_face: Lina: PR opened: https://git.redwood/test/merge/3210 44d3fb includes copy + aria + header CSS. Backend PR linked in description. QA: will run a11y smoke tests once PRs are up. :white_check_mark: Lina: thanks all. closing thread unless there are objections. Mei: :thumbsup: Carlos: :thumbsup:
